jobs.description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?
The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. We can’t wait to get to know you!

We can’t wait to get to know you!

The Work

The Senior Director, Growth and Franchise Value provides strategic leadership for the agenda to deepen relationships across Personal Banking’s combined customer franchise, spanning EQ Bank customers and PC Financial customers. The role establishes the Personal Banking approach to franchise value creation, including customer segmentation and lifetime value economics, joint value propositions and bundled offers, and channel strategy for customer growth. Working across Product, Marketing, Analytics, Loyalty, Digital and Operations, the Senior Director mobilizes cross-functional execution and is accountable for delivering the relationship deepening and franchise growth outcomes established through the annual plan.

Main Activities

Franchising strategy: Establishes and leads the multi-year Personal Banking franchise value strategy across the combined EQ Bank and PC Financial ecosystems. Converts strategic ambition into an integrated portfolio of priorities, targets and investment choices aligned with product leaders and embedded in the annual business plan.
Segmentation and customer value: Sets the strategic framework for cross-product segmentation and customer lifetime value, identifying priority segments and directing growth investment toward opportunities with the strongest long-term franchise economics while balancing customer value, acquisition cost and returns.
Plays, offers and journeys: Provides strategic direction for franchising propositions, bundled offers and end-to-end customer journeys, including onboarding and early-life experiences. Establishes targeting and offer principles within approved investment parameters to strengthen relationship depth and customer value.
Next-best-offer: Serves as the senior business owner for the next-best-offer roadmap, defining strategic priorities, decision rules and business requirements for propensity and decisioning capabilities developed by Analytics, and championing adoption across channels.
Program delivery: Leads the program through cross-functional teams spanning Analytics, Marketing, Product and Digital. Establishes governance, prioritizes the highest-value opportunities, drives disciplined test-and-learn execution, and ensures successful initiatives are scaled based on demonstrable incremental impact.
Franchise performance: Establishes the performance framework for franchise value, including measures, baselines and management insights. Reviews performance through Personal Banking objectives and key results and quarterly business reviews, identifies emerging opportunities or performance gaps, and recommends corrective actions and investment shifts.
Marketing technology and data: Sponsors the business vision and requirements for marketing technology, decisioning, journey orchestration, data and reporting capabilities required to enable a scalable next-best-action and offer decisioning engine, working closely with Business Enablement Technology and Digital.
People leadership: Builds and leads a high-performing team spanning strategy, channel, offer and analytics capabilities. Sets a clear mandate and priorities, develops leadership capability and succession depth, and manages resources and budget to deliver the function’s objectives.
Risk and compliance: Ensures growth strategies, customer targeting and communications operate within regulatory requirements, privacy and consent obligations, and the Bank’s risk appetite. Engages Risk, Compliance, Legal and Privacy early to enable responsible, sustainable growth.

Let's Talk About You!

Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, economics, marketing or a quantitative field required; MBA or CFA designation preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in customer strategy, customer value management or cross-sell, marketing strategy, product management or management consulting, preferably in financial services, retail or loyalty; including 5+ years leading teams of managers and professionals.
Demonstrated success growing multi-product customer relationships, embedding segmentation and lifetime value models in business decisions, and building programs at scale.
Customer segmentation and lifetime value modelling; experimental design (test-and-control); customer relationship management, marketing automation and decisioning platforms; journey orchestration; business intelligence tools; agile ways of working; advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
Exceptional strategic and analytical judgement; sophisticated commercial and financial acumen, including product economics and business cases; demonstrated ability to influence and align senior leaders without direct authority; compelling executive communication; and a highly collaborative, decisive and outcomes-oriented leadership style.
Deep knowledge of Personal Banking economics, operations and performance, with the strategic perspective to shape the future direction of customer growth and relationship deepening. Recognized as a senior thought leader and trusted adviser on customer value, franchising and channel strategy.
Executive-level – develops and presents strategic recommendations to the Personal Banking senior leadership team, influences enterprise priorities, negotiates shared outcomes with strategic partners, and authors senior-level strategies and investment cases.

What we offer [For full-time permanent roles]

💰 Competitive discretionary bonus

✨ Market leading RRSP match program

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits

📝 Employee Share Purchase Plan

👶🏽 Maternity/Parental top-up while you care for your little one

🏝 Generous vacation policy and personal days

🖥 Virtual events to connect with your fellow colleagues

🎓 Professional development and comprehensive Career Development program

💛 A fulfilling opportunity to join one of the top FinTechs and help create a new kind of banking experience

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion

EQ is committed to building an inclusive, accessible environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and supported. We believe our organization is stronger — and our people thrive — when we honour and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives. We’re equally committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally.

Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture

Who We Are

Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets.

Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.

To learn more about who we are visit our website: www.teranet.ca

About the Role

Teranet’s diverse businesses are complex and require healthy architectural oversight to ensure alignment of the technology solutions with the business strategy. This role will have a portfolio of responsibilities related to architecture, strategy, and planning, and will have oversight of the activities of several very senior and experienced technical leaders.

The Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture is accountable for owning and driving architectural solutions across the enterprise, inclusive of line-of-business (LOB), Enterprise IT, and corporate solutions. This role drives the creation and adoption of Teranet’s multi-year IT roadmap. The IT roadmap drives multi-year IT investment decisions and broadly impacts technology spending of ~ $25M (excludes people costs) per year to deliver business value across the enterprise.

All system, technology, and solution architects in Teranet, across the enterprise, will report to this role. As such, this position will have a widespread impact on the business capabilities delivered in partnership with the Registry & Property Solutions, Financial Solutions, Enterprise IT, Information Security, and other departments at Teranet.

Reason for Vacancy: Net New Role

What You’ll Be Doing

Develop IT strategy that maintains alignment between business and IT and which will drive
multi-year IT investment decisions.
Contribute to the development of the company’s strategic roadmap.
Lead Teranet’s enterprise-wide IT roadmap, defining the future-state architecture and transformation of technology, people, organizational design, and processes.
Contribute to the execution of digital transformation efforts.
Define the technology solution and environment roadmaps to ensure capacity and scalability as demand and usage evolve within the business.
Have visibility and understanding of the entire technology landscape.
Identify, assess, and communicate risks related to the roadmaps, to strategic IT initiatives, and to Teranet’s business from emerging technology trends.
Participate, as required, in executive- and board-level discussions on technology and strategy.

Manage a team of architects responsible for creating technology solutions to business problems, developing new business capabilities, and providing technical direction to implementation teams.

Mentor and manage team members to achieve program targets and goals.
Hold direct accountability for all technology and data architects across the enterprise.
Oversee the time management, prioritization, and effectiveness of all team members.
Evaluate team members on their achievement of goals.
Ensure development, coaching, and mentoring plans are in place for all team members.
Prepare and track the budget and forecast for the Enterprise Architecture team.

Govern the practice of architecture at Teranet. Develop principles, processes, and standards and ensure adherence to same.

Chair the architecture board responsible for reviewing and approving architecture, technology, and design decisions across the enterprise.
Partner closely with and maintain regular touchpoints with key partners, including product development, customers, finance, PMO, vendors, and delivery teams.
Manage the allocation of architecture resources to various initiatives.
Create and communicate solutions to various business problems.
Oversee adherence to the architecture strategy, principles, and framework throughout IT.
Lead the definition and validation of architecture principles and standards.
Ensure systems are architected to be secure and resilient through the effective application of architecture principles across the domains of Business, Application, Data, Integration, Technology/Infrastructure, and Security.
Communicate architecture standards to all stakeholders and ensure standards are published, updated, and followed.
Communicate the impacts, trade-offs, risks, costs, benefits, and opportunities of IT decisions as needed.
Stay current on architecture, IT strategy, and technology innovation best practices and trends.
Define and track architecture KPIs/metrics, including standards compliance, technical debt reduction, and reuse rates.

Contribute to the success of M&A activitythrough deep understanding of the business and involvement in most stages of the M&A lifecycle.

Perform technology due diligence.
Evaluate acquisitions for ability to integrate with Teranet and ensure acquisitions include adequate integration funding to (a) realize immediate value and (b) realize efficiencies.
Lead the IT team as it influences the outcome of mergers and acquisitions, ensuring that IT needs are considered and supporting the M&A efforts during and following the deal.

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of progressive leadership and IT experience.
Experience in large, sophisticated organizations.
Demonstrated experience in managing an organization’s complex technology plans.
Demonstrated experience in cross-group coordination across a wide range of management levels and functional disciplines.
Demonstrated experience in developing and supporting mission critical applications.
Exhibited deep knowledge of system architecture, technical design, system and software development technology.
Demonstrated track record of disseminating new insights, changes, and processes across complex and matrixed organizations.
Experience in the real estate and/or financial services industries is an asset.
Technical expertise coupled with an understanding of business principles.
Direct experience leading architecture for major transformation programs, including AI, automation, cloud, and infrastructure initiatives.
Strong knowledge of modern architecture patterns, including microservices, API-led integration, cloud-native, and event-driven architecture.
Experience working within multiple project/SDLC methodologies, including Agile/Scrum and SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).
TOGAF certification (or equivalent enterprise architecture certification) preferred; SAFe certification (e.g., SPC, ARC) a plus.

Agility/Capability/Leadership

Strong knowledge of emerging digital technologies, including cloud, SaaS/PaaS, APIs, mobile, AI and machine learning, with experience across platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
Demonstrated ability to identify, assess and leverage emerging technologies to drive innovation, business value and competitive advantage.
Experience with modern DevOps, platform engineering and AI/ML architecture practices, including responsible AI and governance considerations.
Strong business and technology acumen, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts and opportunities into clear business terms.
Proven leadership experience building, developing, motivating and inspiring high-performing teams while fostering transparency, accountability and shared purpose.
Strong executive presence, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, business and senior leadership teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead change, establish priorities, remove barriers and drive results in complex and fast-paced environments.
Strong critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience navigating large-scale technology environments and ambiguous situations.
A collaborative and authentic leader who demonstrates empathy, strong listening skills, sound judgment and effective conflict resolution.
Results-oriented, adaptable and highly motivated, with the ability to remain calm, focused and decisive through change and uncertainty.

Company Overview

ABOUT SUPRA ITS

Founded in 1999, Supra ITS has grown into a globally trusted IT partner, delivering world-class Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Application Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services. Headquartered in Mississauga, Supra ITS operates with 650+ employees worldwide, including Network Operations Centers (NOCs) in Canada and India, ensuring 24/7 IT support and seamless service delivery.

Canon Canada’s strategic investment in Supra ITS strengthens this commitment by integrating Canon’s cutting-edge technologies with Supra’s agile IT services. This partnership fosters innovation, enhances efficiency, and accelerates digital transformation, providing customers with superior IT solutions that are scalable, secure, and customer centric.

For more information, visit www.supraits.com.

Team Overview

This is your opportunity to join a dynamic company with a team that works very well together and has solid organized structures in place. Supra is rebuilding its Managed Services customer organization around a pod model: every customer has a named Account Manager who owns the relationship and the revenue, paired with a Customer IT Manager (CITM) who acts as the technical co-pilot for architecture, security, and the technology roadmap. The function spans Canada and India: a Senior Account Manager, Account Managers, and an Account Executive in Canada, Account Managers in India, and CITMs in both countries, together covering Supra’s managed services customer base.

YOU ARE!

You have built and led customer teams that own a number.
You have run account management, customer success, or client services in a managed services, cloud, or technology services business, and you know how to turn a team of relationship owners and technical advisors into one accountable unit that renews, grows, and keeps customers.

You understand recurring revenue in your bones.
Gross and net revenue retention, MRR movements, renewal rates, margin, and cost to serve are the numbers you manage by. You can explain to a CFO why an account is at risk a quarter before it shows up in churn, and you can explain to an Account Manager exactly what to do about it.

You lead from the field.
You are the executive your largest customers know by name. You show up for the quarterly reviews that matter, you run the saves personally when they are big enough, and you coach your team by doing the work alongside them, not from a dashboard.

The Director of Customer Success leads Supra’s Managed Services customer organization in Canada and India: the Account Management team (Senior Account Manager, Account Managers, Account Executives) and the Customer IT Manager (CITM) team. You own retention, growth, and customer experience across the full managed services base: gross and net revenue retention, renewals, expansion, customer health, the quarterly business review and technology roadmap cadence, and the coverage model that assigns every customer a relationship owner and a technical co-pilot. You hire, develop, and hold the team accountable to a weekly scorecard, act as executive sponsor for the largest and most at-risk accounts, and represent the voice of the customer in pricing, service catalogue, and delivery decisions. The role reports to the Senior Vice President, Sales
, based in Canada.

This is a leadership role based at Supra’s Mississauga office with significant customer-facing time. Supra is a hybrid workplace, but this position is expected to be in front of customers or with the team most of the week: executive sponsorship visits, quarterly business reviews for Tier A accounts, and ride-alongs with Account Managers across the GTA and Southern Ontario. Time working from home will be limited. Periodic travel to Supra’s India operations is expected to lead the India-based Account Managers and CITMs. A valid Ontario driver’s licence and access to a reliable vehicle are required.

Key Responsibilities Leadership of the Account Management and CITM Teams

Lead, hire, develop, and performance-manage the Account Management team (Senior Account Manager, Account Managers, Account Executives) in Canada and India and the CITM team in both countries.
Run the pod model: every customer has a named Account Manager and, where warranted, a CITM; books are balanced, seats are filled with the right people, and accountability for each account is unambiguous.
Set role charters, cadences, and the weekly scorecard for every seat; run the weekly team meeting, quarterly planning, and one-on-ones in Supra’s operating rhythm.
Build the career ladder and coaching plan from Associate Account Executive to Senior Account Manager and across the CITM track.

Retention, Growth, and Book Economics

Own gross and net revenue retention, renewal rate, and expansion bookings for the entire managed services base; build the annual revenue plan for the base by account and forecast it monthly.
Own the renewal pipeline: no renewal is a surprise, every agreement is opened early, and rate and margin are protected.
Drive roadmap-led expansion across the portfolio (managed security, cloud and infrastructure, Microsoft, application and AI services, hardware) by making the annual technology roadmap the standard for every Tier A and Tier B account.
Manage cost to serve: coverage ratios, Canada and India seat mix, and the use of programmatic coverage for the long tail.

Run monthly account reviews with leadership covering at-risk accounts, renewals, and expansion pipeline.

Customer Experience And Operating Cadence

Be the voice of the customer inside Supra: feed customer requirements into pricing, packaging, service catalogue, and delivery decisions, and close the loop with customers on what changed.

Collaboration Across Supra
